entities.summary:
Ali Sadreddine Al-Bayanouni is a Muslim Brotherhood leader in exile in London. He was born in 1938 in Aleppo and brought up in a religious family, where his father and grandfather were both well-known Muslim scholars. He joined the Muslim Brotherhood while in secondary school, in 1954, and went on to graduate with a law degree from the University of Damascus in 1963.

He served as a reserve officer in the Syrian Army from 1959 to 1960. Bayanouni became a member of the Syrian Muslim Brotherhood's Shura Council and Executive Office in 1972. Ali Sadreddine Al-Bayanouni was a legal figures from Aleppo (b. 1938, Aleppo). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

His involvement in the Shura Council and Executive Office helped shape the organization's policies and direction.
